supersedes: v0.4 (2026-04-24, tissue arm added with VAL-063). v0.3 (2026-04-24, universal reference block). v0.2 multi_modal_validated from VAL-056. v0.1 initial. v0.4 adds tissue_arm block with VAL-063 TCGA-LUAD (Lung Adenocarcinoma) cycling-class validation: pooled paired d = +1.0202 p = 3.93e-08, plus full CCL-009 smoking-stratified analysis (ever-smoker d = +1.283, lifelong non-smoker d = +0.567 underpowered at n=2). Largest cycling-class tissue effect in the Cookbook to date. v0.5 adds VAL-097 GSE256092 Korean NSLA never-smoker cross-cohort vs TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal. Outcome O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED — cross-cohort comparison structurally invalid due to SWAN-vs-sesame preprocessing pipeline mismatch + Korean-vs-Western population baseline shift + bulk-tumor-vs-adjacent-normal cell-composition difference. Lung_cells tile d=-0.27 (second-weakest of 25 tiles); 22/25 tiles uniformly positive; 11/25 breach >3 anchor-SD. Never-smoker LUAD tissue tile pattern remains uncharacterized; VAL-098 queued on GSE235414 with internal matched adjacent-normal samples. CCL-037 LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION + CCL-038 LL-PRELOCK-DEGENERATE-COMPARATOR lessons logged. EDEAR commercial deployment unaffected per CCL-037 single-pipeline patient-vs-internal-reference clarification.
disease: Non-small-cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC), including adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma
universal_pipeline_acknowledgment: Per README_MASTER_v2.1 THE UNIVERSAL RULE: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This card inherits that pipeline unchanged. Lung-specific differences: expected direction positive, Stage 2 localization to lung_epithelial, smoking status as mandatory covariate with per-stratum clinical action paths.

panel.source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
panel.rationale: Same universal Xu-538 panel used by breast, CRC, AD cards. Panel measures immune-class architectural state; lung drives that state positively per VAL-046 UK Biobank cohort-level pattern. Smoking-adjusted directional panel for lung is a future refinement (see known_limitations).

stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score (mean of H(β)/H_min across panel CpGs)
stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method_secondary: No lung-directional panel at v0.2. When UK Biobank (TODO 8.2) or CLUE II access opens and per-patient Phase 9/12 runs, a smoker-stratified directional panel will be derived per VAL-051 methodology.

VAL_046_cohort_level.cohort: UK Biobank lung cancer pre-diagnostic subset n=680
VAL_046_cohort_level.result: mean ΔA = +0.014 at 2-5yr pre-dx across ≥2 architecture classes including immune
VAL_046_cohort_level.note: Cohort-level support; per-patient validation pending access

VAL_039_lung_tissue_field_effect.result: tumor ΔA = +0.152 (FLOOR_BREACH), near-adjacent 2cm ΔA = +0.052 (MARGINAL), far-adjacent 5cm ΔA = +0.017 (sub-MARGINAL but elevated), healthy non-smoker ΔA = 0.000. Monotonic tumor→near→far→healthy. Field effect extends beyond 5 cm from tumor margin.

TCGA_LUAD_LUSC_tumor_normal.cohort: TCGA-LUAD n=82 matched pairs, TCGA-LUSC n=59 matched pairs
TCGA_LUAD_LUSC_tumor_normal.result: LUAD tumor ΔA = +0.165 (FLOOR_BREACH), LUSC tumor ΔA = +0.161 (FLOOR_BREACH). Adjacent-normal ΔA ≈ +0.03 in both — field effect signature in TCGA solid-tissue-normal. Note: TCGA lung cohorts are approximately 80% smokers/former-smokers at diagnosis, so the +0.03 adjacent-normal baseline reflects combined smoking + local field effect.

NORMAL.action: No further workup. Serial-sample next interval per screening cadence.

MARGINAL.action: Note, no immediate action. Serial-sample in 6 months. Document smoking status.

DETECTABLE.action: Run Stage 2 localization. If lung_epithelial localizes with confidence, lung-epic card fires per clinical action matrix.

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2 localization. Lung-epic fires with URGENT workup per clinical action matrix.

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2 localization. Clinical workup regardless of localization; if lung_epithelial fires, expedite CT and pulmonology consult per matrix.

stage_1_immune_flag.tier_source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference table. Same as breast-epic and crc-epic cards.

smoking_status.rationale: F2RL3 (cg03636183) and AHRR (cg05575921) are smoking-driven and overlap with the Xu-538 panel. Current smokers have elevated immune A-score independent of lung cancer. Baglietto 2017 (doi:10.1002/ijc.30431) shows smoking CpGs recover toward never-smoker values over 5-10 years post-cessation. Hong 2019 (doi:10.3390/jcm8091307) shows per-CpG genome-wide significant DMPs (cg12169243 DPH6, cg25429010 IMP3) in current smokers only, not nonsmokers — NSCLC methylation signature is smoking-stratified at the CpG level.
smoking_status.deployment_rule_current_smoker: Report MUST include: 'Smoking exposure contributes independently to immune-class methylation drift. This A-score elevation may reflect combined smoking effect and early lung-architectural change. Clinical assessment should consider both. Lung-epic firing requires Stage 2 localization confidence to distinguish smoking-only from smoking+cancer.'
smoking_status.deployment_rule_never_smoker: Report is cleaner — no smoking confound. If A_immune elevates and Stage 2 localizes to lung_epithelial, cancer workup proceeds. Consider EGFR mutation testing at early workup (never-smoker NSCLC is predominantly EGFR-mutant adenocarcinoma).
smoking_status.deployment_rule_former_smoker: Report must include years-since-quit. If >10 years quit, interpretation closer to never-smoker. If <5 years, closer to current smoker. Baglietto 2017 smoking-CpG decay kinetics are the reference.

age.handling: age-matched baseline per 80-cell reference, decade-stratified means and SDs

sex.handling: Report sex. No sex-specific tier thresholds at v0.2. NSCLC histology distribution differs by sex (adenocarcinoma more common in women and never-smokers; squamous cell more common in men and smokers) but evidence for sex-specific immune-panel thresholds is absent at v0.2.

stage_2_localization.trigger: Stage 1 flag at DETECTABLE tier or higher
stage_2_localization.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the same IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values

lung_specific_expectation.expected_confidence_ratio_top1_vs_top2: >20x based on VAL-056 Moss deconvolution result (observed 60.87x)

validation_anchor_VAL_041.result: Top-1 lung_epithelial ΔA = +0.14304; Top-2 neuron ΔA = +0.00235; ratio 60.87x. Extremely clean localization.

interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_lung_epithelial_and_ratio_ove: HIGH-CONFIDENCE lung localization — lung-epic fires with full clinical action matrix
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_lung_epithelial_and_ratio_1p5: MODERATE-CONFIDENCE — lung-epic fires with caveat; report also names top-2 tissue for clinician awareness
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_lung_epithelial_and_ratio_und: AMBIGUOUS — both tissues reported, recommend broader workup
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_NOT_lung_epithelial: Lung-epic does NOT fire. Relevant tissue's card fires instead.

clinical_action_matrix.purpose: When Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 localizes to lung_epithelial with sufficient confidence, produce disease-specific clinical guidance by tier × smoking status. Never generic.

matrix.action: Low-dose chest CT (LDCT) per USPSTF 2021 criteria if not on annual screening. Pulmonology review of any existing imaging.
Standard chest CT. EGFR mutation testing consideration if adenocarcinoma suspected. Pulmonology consult.
Expedited LDCT within 4-6 weeks. Follow Fleischner Society guidelines if nodules found. Pulmonology consult. Repeat EDEAR at 6 months for trajectory.

Expedited standard chest CT within 4-6 weeks. Pulmonology consult. Consider broader malignancy workup if CT negative — lung Stage 2 signal in never-smoker with negative CT warrants ruling out occult lung primary plus considering other cycling-class tissues.

Urgent chest CT (not LDCT) within 2 weeks regardless of smoking status. Pulmonology consult. If CT negative and lung_epithelial remains dominant at Stage 2 on repeat EDEAR at 3 months, consider bronchoscopy with BAL methylation if clinically available. Quarterly EDEAR until A-score returns below DETECTABLE.

clinical_action_matrix.ambiguous_localization_rule: If Stage 2 top-1 ΔA is not 2x greater than top-2 ΔA, report both tissues, workup the more clinically concerning first, clinician decides.
clinical_action_matrix.marginal_tier_rule: MARGINAL (A ≥ 1.01 but < 1.05) triggers serial-sample at 6 months rather than imaging, even if Stage 2 suggests lung_epithelial.
clinical_action_matrix.smoking_adjustment_sentence_mandatory_fo: Report must include: 'Smoking exposure contributes independently to immune-class methylation drift. This A-score elevation may reflect combined smoking effect and early lung-architectural change.'

validation_tier: multi_modal_validated (blood, VAL-056) + cycling_class_tissue_validated (tissue, VAL-063) + stage_2_only_validated (VAL-041 deconvolution). Second Cookbook card with validated cycling-class tissue arm after crc-epic (VAL-062).

tissue_arm.description: Tissue arm of the lung-epic card. LUAD = Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA project code for the most common NSCLC subtype, ~40% of lung cancers, occurring in both smokers and never-smokers). Uses TCGA-LUAD HM450 matched tumor/normal biopsies, cycling-class scoring. LUAD is one of 14 cycling-class TCGA cancers (Issue 002 Cycling Epithelial chapter).

cohort.source: TCGA-LUAD HM450 via NIH GDC public API
cohort.qc_filter: Minimum 400,000 valid beta values per sample (~82% of HM450 probes)

arm_primary_VAL063_tumor_architecture_cy.what_it_reads: Lung adenocarcinoma tumor cell architecture (lung_epithelial = cycling class)
arm_primary_VAL063_tumor_architecture_cy.cpg_subset: all valid HM450 CpGs per sample (tissue biopsy, no deconvolution needed)
arm_primary_VAL063_tumor_architecture_cy.preregistered_prediction: paired d > 0, 95% CI > 0, d >= +0.5 (strong cycling-class signal)
arm_primary_VAL063_tumor_architecture_cy.outcome_vs_prediction: PASS (strong) — all three criteria met with substantial margin; direction confirmed, magnitude very strong

comparison_to_other_tissue_arms.interpretation: Largest paired tissue effect size in the Cookbook. Ordering d(lung) > d(CRC) > d(breast) > d(prostate) consistent with tumor mutational burden ordering — smoking-driven lung TMB is the highest among cycling-class cancers.

arm_primary_VAL063_tumor_architecture_cy.genome_wide_vs_class_specific_note: The +0.043 genome-wide-mean delta_A is smaller than the VAL-001 framework prediction of +0.14 because VAL-001 is calibrated on cycling-class-discriminating CpG subsets (lung-specific DMRs, Moss 2018 lung markers) while VAL-063 averages all approximately 485K HM450 CpGs. Same caveat as VAL-062. Strong Cohen's d preserved by small between-patient variance at genome-wide-mean level.

validation_tier_progression.card_wide_tier: multi_modal_validated (blood) + cycling_class_tissue_validated (tissue, VAL-063) + stage_2_only_validated (VAL-041 deconvolution) — second Cookbook card with tissue arm validated in cycling class (crc-epic was first)

smoking_stratification_CCL_009.mandate: CCL-009 requires smoking stratification for all lung-epic validations. Smoking drives independent immune-class methylation (F2RL3 cg03636183, AHRR cg05575921 per Baglietto 2017 and Hong 2019). VAL-063 ran pooled cohort AND full smoking-stratified analysis.

current_smoker.note: n=2 too small for reliable inference

lifelong_non_smoker.note: direction positive but CI wide; too small for independent statistical inference

not_reported.note: borderline, 5/29 unreported is expected noise floor

smoking_stratification_CCL_009.interpretation: Direction consistent across all strata (all paired d > 0). Magnitude dominated by ever-smokers (22/29 = 76% of TCGA-LUAD). Never-smoker arm is underpowered (n=2) and cannot independently resolve never-smoker cycling-class disruption magnitude. Pooled VAL-063 d = +1.02 reflects ever-smoker-dominated cohort. Framework prediction (positive direction in all strata, magnitude scales with mutational pressure) consistent with observed ordering.
smoking_stratification_CCL_009.limitation_declared: TCGA-LUAD cohort cannot distinguish never-smoker cycling-class disruption from smoker-confounded signal at adequate statistical power. VAL-063b on a never-smoker-enriched LUAD cohort (East Asian, where never-smoker LUAD is 50-70% of cases) recommended for future validation.

never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.status: O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED — cross-cohort comparison structurally invalidated; never-smoker LUAD tissue tile pattern remains UNCHARACTERIZED

cohort.name: GSE256092
cohort.description: Korean NSLA tumor tissue, all never-smoker by cohort definition

cross_cohort_reference.name: TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal
cross_cohort_reference.access: NIH GDC public API at https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/{file_id}

never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.method: 25-tile Loyfer atlas per-class A-score on every sample; top-100 marker CpGs per tile; H_min frozen from G-002 + G-003b MCMC posteriors; bootstrap 10000 d CI; cross-cohort baseline check (CHK-3.2) per tile in pooled-SD anchor units
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.reference_atlas: Loyfer 2023 array atlas, atlas_vault/stage2_cell_of_origin/loyfer_moss_2018/reference_atlas.csv (7,890 array CpGs x 25 cell types)
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.top1_dominant_tile_across_141_patients: B-cells_EPIC in 79/141 (56%) — interpreted as tumor-infiltrating-lymphocyte signal vs adjacent-normal contrast, not lung-of-origin biology
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.final_outcome_reason: Three stacked sources of non-biological variance: SWAN-vs-sesame preprocessing pipeline mismatch + Korean-vs-Western population baseline shift + bulk-tumor-vs-adjacent-normal cell-composition difference. Cross-cohort comparison structurally invalid for this cohort pair without batch correction (ComBat/BMIQ/RUV).
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.within_cohort_stratification_stands: Per CCL-034, within-cohort stratification (sex x age decade x stage) does NOT depend on cross-cohort reference and remains interpretable on its own terms; reported in stratified.json
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.never_smoker_characterization_status: OPEN — VAL-098 follow-up recommended on GSE235414 with internal matched adjacent-normal samples (proper within-cohort case-vs-control per CHK-3.8 condition 1)
never_smoker_characterization_VAL097.edear_commercial_deployment_unaffected: EDEAR commercial deployment is single-pipeline patient-vs-internal-reference by construction. Cross-cohort calibration boundary applies exclusively to retrospective cookbook validation. Patient one is just as valid as patient one thousand because the reference is the public Loyfer/Moss/Tanaka atlases anchored through L1 partner-lab pipeline calibration.

validation_tier_rationale: VAL-056 (4/4 predictions pass) anchors the card to three independent datasets: (1) Kadota 2014 lung distance gradient confirms lung-tissue field effect monotonic tumor→near→far→healthy with ΔA_tumor=+0.152, ΔA_far_5cm=+0.017 (field extends). (2) Moss 2018 Fig 4b lung plasma deconvolution confirms Stage 2 localization at 60.87x confidence ratio (cleanest localization in the VAL-041 set). (3) TCGA-LUAD n=82 + LUSC n=59 confirms crystallized-cancer magnitude ΔA=+0.165 and +0.161 respectively. Plus VAL-046 UK Biobank cohort-level support (gated). Per-patient blood methylation pre-diagnostic remains pending data access; cross_platform_validated tier awaits UK Biobank or CLUE II run.

validation_evidence_summary.stage_2_localization: CONFIRMED — VAL-041 Moss 2018 Fig 4b: lung_epithelial top-1 with ΔA = +0.14304, confidence ratio 60.87× top-2.
validation_evidence_summary.lung_tissue_field_effect: CONFIRMED — VAL-039 / Kadota 2014 lung adenocarcinoma distance gradient, n=152 total samples. Tumor ΔA = +0.15150, far-adjacent (≥5 cm) ΔA = +0.01702.
validation_evidence_summary.crystallized_cancer_magnitude: CONFIRMED — TCGA-LUAD tumor ΔA = +0.16494, TCGA-LUSC tumor ΔA = +0.16144. Both exceed +0.10 crystallized tier.
validation_evidence_summary.stage_1_per_patient_blood_pre_diagnostic: PENDING — no public blood methylation cohort with n ≥ 100 lung cases and TtD metadata is accessible as of 2026-04-24. Candidates: UK Biobank (TODO 8.2), CLUE II (direct PI contact), MCCS (EGA phs003213 application).
validation_evidence_summary.smoker_never_smoker_stratification: LITERATURE-DOCUMENTED — Hong 2019 Korean NSCLC n=150+150 shows cg12169243 DPH6 and cg25429010 IMP3 reach genome-wide significance in current smokers only. Card v0.2 specifies mandatory smoking covariate reporting and separate clinical action paths per smoking stratum.

never_smoker_lung_tissue_characterizatio.cohort: GSE256092 (n=141 Korean NSLA EPIC) vs TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal (n=29 HM450)
never_smoker_lung_tissue_characterizatio.top1_distribution_lung_cells: 0 of 141 patients (Lung_cells is NOT the most-departed tile in any patient)
never_smoker_lung_tissue_characterizatio.interpretation: Cross-cohort comparison invalidated by stacked preprocessing-pipeline + population + cell-composition mismatches. Result reflects β-value scale shift across SWAN-vs-sesame normalization, Korean-vs-Western baseline, and tumor-vs-adjacent-normal composition — NOT never-smoker LUAD biology. The lung-of-origin tile reading at d=-0.27 is consistent with universal-scale-shift artifact, not direction inversion.
never_smoker_lung_tissue_characterizatio.never_smoker_characterization_status: remains UNCHARACTERIZED; VAL-098 queued on GSE235414
never_smoker_lung_tissue_characterizatio.tier_contribution: NONE — VAL-097 documents a structural-invalidity pattern in cross-cohort retrospective validation; does not promote or demote card tier

known_limitations: Per-patient blood methylation pre-diagnostic validation PENDING. VAL-056 anchors the card to tissue-level (Kadota, TCGA) and deconvolution-level (Moss) evidence; per-patient blood signal awaits UK Biobank (TODO 8.2), CLUE II (direct PI), or MCCS (EGA phs003213) access.

Smoking is a major confounder. Current smokers have elevated immune A-score from smoking-driven F2RL3/AHRR hypomethylation independent of cancer. Current-smoker reports require the mandatory smoking-adjustment sentence. A smoking-adjusted lung panel (subtracting F2RL3/AHRR/2q37.1 smoking CpGs) is a future refinement.

Histology stratification (NSCLC adenocarcinoma vs squamous cell vs small cell) not yet addressed at v0.2. TCGA-LUAD and LUSC both show FLOOR_BREACH tumor ΔA of comparable magnitude. Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) not tested separately — higher-proliferation SCLC may show distinct signature.

Never-smoker NSCLC (predominantly EGFR-mutant adenocarcinoma, more common in women and East Asian populations) may have a different immune signature than smoking-driven NSCLC. Hong 2019 found no genome-wide significant DMPs in Korean never-smokers, though per-CpG directional analysis would likely recover signal.

Stage 2 deconvolution production module (G-DECONV-001) is OPEN-DEFERRED — same status as breast and CRC cards. VAL-056 Moss result was computed at published-β level; production per-IDAT deployment requires the 30 MB Moss reference matrix and Salas 2018 QC harness.

TCGA lung cohorts are approximately 80% smokers/former-smokers. The +0.030 adjacent-normal ΔA observed in TCGA-LUAD reflects combined smoking effect and field effect. Deployment in a never-smoker population will likely show a lower baseline adjacent-normal ΔA.
Single-timepoint sensitivity at 95% specificity unknown at v0.2. Deployment model is Stage 2-anchored flagging with tier × smoking-status clinical action matrix, not standalone screening.

VAL-097 (2026-04-28) attempted cross-cohort never-smoker LUAD tissue characterization on GSE256092 (Korean NSLA EPIC SWAN, n=141) vs TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal (HM450 sesame, n=29) and returned O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED. The cross-cohort comparison was structurally invalidated by SWAN-vs-sesame preprocessing pipeline mismatch + Korean-vs-Western population baseline shift + bulk-tumor-vs-adjacent-normal cell-composition difference. Lung_cells tile read d=-0.27 (second-weakest of 25 tiles); 22/25 tiles uniformly positive; 11/25 breached >3 anchor-SD. Never-smoker LUAD tissue tile pattern therefore remains UNCHARACTERIZED. Per CCL-037 LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION, cross-cohort comparison without batch correction (ComBat/BMIQ/RUV) is structurally invalid for this cohort pair. VAL-098 queued on GSE235414 with internal matched adjacent-normal samples. EDEAR commercial deployment is unaffected per the commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_validation_limitations block.
next_validation_steps: TODO 8.2: Submit UK Biobank methylation subset data-access application. When approved, run Phase 9/12-equivalent on n=680 lung pre-dx cases. Upgrade card to cross_platform_validated if per-patient Cohen's d confirms.
Direct PI contact Michaud (Tufts) and Kelsey (Brown) for CLUE II public release. EPIC 850K, n=430, median 14yr pre-dx — longest pre-diagnostic window of any candidate cohort.
Develop smoking-adjusted lung panel. Subtract F2RL3 (cg03636183), AHRR (cg05575921), and 2q37.1 smoking CpGs from the score to enable interpretable reports in current smokers.
Histology-stratified directional panels for adenocarcinoma vs squamous cell — leverage TCGA-LUAD and LUSC tissue-level data once blood cohort Phase 9/12 establishes a baseline.

VAL-098: Re-attempt never-smoker LUAD tissue tile pattern characterization using GSE235414 (driver-stratified LUAD with internal matched adjacent-normal samples in the same cohort and same pipeline — proper within-cohort case-vs-control per CHK-3.8 condition 1). Avoids the SWAN-vs-sesame + Korean-vs-Western + tumor-vs-adjacent-normal stacked-mismatch problem that invalidated VAL-097.

reproducibility_anchors.h_min_source_constants: GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96 (frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means)

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned._purpose: Disease-specific quirks encountered during validation and deployment.

lessons.context: TCGA matched tumor-normal lung n=141 total pairs
lessons.quirk: Adjacent-normal ΔA = +0.030 in both LUAD and LUSC — substantially elevated above healthy-donor baseline. Tumor ΔA = +0.165 and +0.161.
lessons.interpretation: TCGA lung cohorts are ~80% smokers/former-smokers at diagnosis. The +0.030 adjacent-normal ΔA reflects combined smoking effect and local field effect, not a pure tissue field effect. Deployment in a never-smoker population will likely show a lower baseline adjacent-normal.
lessons.applied_to_card: known_limitations explicitly flags this; mandatory smoking-status covariate; per-stratum clinical action paths.

lessons.quirk: cg12169243 (DPH6) and cg25429010 (IMP3) reached genome-wide significance in current smokers only, not nonsmokers. The NSCLC methylation signature is smoking-stratified at the per-CpG level.
lessons.interpretation: Single-panel one-size-fits-all scoring is inappropriate for lung cancer. Current-smoker NSCLC signature combines smoking damage response + cancer response. Never-smoker NSCLC (often EGFR-mutant adenocarcinoma, more common in women and East Asian populations) has a distinct signature.
lessons.applied_to_card: Four smoking strata (never / former ≥10yr / former <5yr / current) each with explicit deployment rule; Stage 2 firing rule tightened for current smokers (top-1/top-2 ≥ 2x, not DETECTABLE alone).

lessons.quirk: Smoking-driven CpG hypomethylation decays back toward never-smoker values over 5-10 years post-cessation.
lessons.interpretation: Former-smoker interpretation depends on time-since-quit. >10yr quit → approximately never-smoker. <5yr quit → approximately current-smoker. 5-10yr → intermediate.
lessons.applied_to_card: mandatory_covariates.smoking_status includes four strata with per-stratum deployment rule. Years-since-quit is a required field when former smoker stratum is selected.

lessons.quirk: Top-1 lung_epithelial ΔA = +0.14304 vs top-2 neuron ΔA = +0.00235 — confidence ratio 60.87x. This is the cleanest tissue-of-origin localization in the entire VAL-041 10-cancer set.
lessons.interpretation: Stage 2 lung specificity is exceptionally strong. Lung can use the top-1/top-2 ratio ≥ 2x firing rule without losing sensitivity because the ratio is nearly always much higher when lung is the true tissue. This justifies the tightened Stage 2 rule for smokers.
lessons.applied_to_card: Stage 2 firing rule top-1/top-2 ≥ 2x tightening for current smokers is supported by Moss 60.87x ratio; maintains high sensitivity.

lessons.context: Lung adenocarcinoma distance-annotated field effect n=152
lessons.quirk: Monotonic gradient tumor (+0.152) → near 2cm (+0.052) → far 5cm (+0.017) → healthy. Far-adjacent (≥5cm) remains elevated above healthy by +0.017 — field effect extends past the resection margin.
lessons.interpretation: In surgical resection for early-stage lung cancer, a "clean" 5cm margin is still architecturally elevated. EDEAR lung-epic serial monitoring post-resection should track return-to-baseline trajectory rather than expecting immediate A-score normalization.
lessons.applied_to_card: post-operative surveillance language in clinical_action_matrix: "post-resection patients should expect gradual A-score decline over months, not immediate return to baseline."

lessons.context: Cross-cohort never-smoker LUAD tissue characterization on GSE256092 (Korean NSLA EPIC SWAN, n=141) vs TCGA-LUAD adjacent-normal (HM450 sesame, n=29).
lessons.quirk: Cross-cohort comparison returned 22 of 25 Loyfer tiles uniformly positive, 11 of 25 breaching >3 anchor-SD on CHK-3.2, lung-of-origin tile reading second-weakest at d=-0.27, and top-1 ΔA call landing on B-cells_EPIC in 79/141 (56%) of patients. Three stacked sources of non-biological variance dominated the disease signal: SWAN-vs-sesame preprocessing pipeline mismatch + Korean-vs-Western population baseline shift + bulk-tumor-vs-adjacent-normal cell-composition difference.
lessons.interpretation: When two methylation cohorts use different preprocessing pipelines AND different platforms AND different populations without batch correction, the β-value scale shift dominates the disease signal. Cross-cohort retrospective comparison is structurally invalid for such cohort pairs. Per CCL-037 LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION, future cross-cohort VALs must satisfy one of three conditions: (1) within-cohort paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal in a single cohort, (2) re-process both cohorts through the same pipeline, or (3) apply batch correction with healthy-vs-healthy anchor samples. EDEAR commercial deployment is unaffected — single-pipeline patient-vs-internal-reference comparison has no cross-cohort calibration problem.
lessons.applied_to_card: never_smoker_characterization_VAL097 block added to tissue_arm with explicit O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED status and uncharacterized-status flag for the never-smoker LUAD tissue tile pattern. VAL-098 queued on GSE235414 (driver-stratified LUAD with internal matched adjacent-normal in same cohort same pipeline). Card-wide commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_validation_limitations block added at top level. lung-LL-006 logged in master LESSONS_LEARNED.md as part of CCL-037.

lessons.context: O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED auto-assignment criterion in VAL-097 prereg failed to fire when it should have. Original criterion: "max baseline_anchor_SD > max case_vs_reference_d" — but baseline_anchor_SD = (case_mean - ref_mean)/pooled_SD, which equals case-vs-reference Cohen's d when n_case >> n_ref dominates pooled variance. The two quantities are the same number; comparing them is comparing a number to itself.
lessons.quirk: Auto-assigned outcome was O2_CYCLING_DISTRIBUTED, which was wrong on every reading: 22/25 tiles uniformly positive, lung tile second-weakest, top-1 call was an immune tile in 56% of patients, 11/25 tiles breached the structural-invalidity threshold. Honest reading was O5_BASELINE_DOMINATED. CHK-4.8 honest-revision applied to override.
lessons.interpretation: Pre-locked decision criteria must be tested for degenerate-comparator failures during prereg review, not after the run. Future O5 criteria must test the breach pattern directly: ≥3 tiles >3 anchor-SD AND ≥80% same-direction = baseline-dominated, regardless of relative magnitude vs d. CHK-4.10 in TESTING_CHECKLIST.md encodes this as the runtime check. Per CCL-038 LL-PRELOCK-DEGENERATE-COMPARATOR, every existing VAL with pre-locked outcome auto-assignment gets a retrospective audit pass.
lessons.applied_to_card: lung-LL-007 logged in master LESSONS_LEARNED.md as part of CCL-038. Future lung-epic VALs (including VAL-098) use the pattern-based O5 criterion verbatim.

commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali._purpose: Per CCL-037 LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION (signed off 2026-04-28), the cross-cohort calibration boundary applies exclusively to retrospective cookbook validation. EDEAR commercial deployment uses a single calibrated pipeline against a fixed reference distribution and is unaffected by the validation-side limitations documented in this card.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.deployment_architecture: One partner lab generates the patient IDAT through a single calibrated normalization protocol. That same partner lab has, during L1 onboarding, run a calibration anchor batch that aligns their β-value output to the public Loyfer/Moss/Tanaka atlas reference frame. Every patient's IDAT runs through that same pipeline. Every patient is compared to the same calibrated reference distribution per substrate.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.first_patient_calibration: No cold-start problem. The Loyfer 25-tile array atlas is built from sorted purified cells across 25 healthy human tissues — not patient data, curated cell-type ground truth. The H_min values are frozen from MCMC posteriors on healthy cell populations (G-002 + G-003b, R-hat < 1.001) and do not move between patients. The L1 partner-lab calibration anchor confirms the partner lab's specific normalization aligns with the atlas reference frame; it is done once at onboarding and refreshed periodically. Patient one is just as valid as patient one thousand.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.internal_reference_secondary: The internal reference distribution accumulates over time as a secondary anchor that becomes more refined for whatever population the partner lab serves. It is not a prerequisite for deployment.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.cross_cohort_calibration_boundary_does_n: EDEAR does not compare two patient cohorts to each other. EDEAR compares one patient to a fixed atlas reference within one calibrated pipeline. There is no cross-cohort comparison at deployment, therefore no cross-cohort calibration problem at deployment.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.marketing_language_unchanged: EDEAR fires a red flag early enough that the patient sees a doctor while there is time to act. EDEAR is health-and-wellness early-detection, not regulated diagnostic. Cookbook validation limitations (LL-PUBLIC-TIER public-tier-only operational mode, LL-CROSS-COHORT-CALIBRATION cross-cohort batch-correction requirement) are scientific honesty about retrospective evidence; they are not deployment limitations.
commercial_deployment_unaffected_by_vali.val_097_lesson_in_deployment_terms: When a real patient with a real lung tumor sends in their IDAT through EDEAR, the lung_cells tile WILL fire because tumor lung cells diverge from healthy lung methylation as captured by the Loyfer reference. The immune tiles will fire too because of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes contributing methylation signal. Pancreas, prostate, breast, brain, and unrelated tissues will stay near baseline. The pattern of WHICH tiles co-fire is the diagnostic information. VAL-063 already demonstrated this for ever-smoker LUAD on TCGA-LUAD paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal: clean paired d=+1.02 at the cycling class, lung-of-origin signal preserved against same-cohort same-pipeline reference.
